site.name: Dugudugu
site.description: A playful random-decision arcade that turns draws, ladder games, and races into polished 3D and crisp 2D moments worth watching together.

lobby.heroTitle:
The five seconds before
the answer are the best.
lobby.heroBody: Pick a draw, ladder, or race and add the names. A fair result plays out as a tiny game worth watching together.
lobby.heading: How should we decide today?
lobby.subheading: No dashboard full of tools—just a few little games made to watch and cheer together.

draw.title: Capsule Draw
draw.short: Spin a capsule and reveal the pick
draw.tagline: A random draw with a rolling capsule reveal
draw.description: Add names or items, press the button, and the machine mixes capsules before revealing the result. Seeded randomness keeps every pick fair for bets, chores, or splitting teams.

stage.openPrompt: Tap the winning capsule to open it

intro.capsuleSync: The chamber fills as you add entries
intro.openCapsule: Tap the dispensed capsule to open it

faq.q: How do I use Capsule Draw?
faq.a: Enter one option per line and press Draw capsule. When the machine dispenses the winner, tap that capsule to open it and see the result.
Yes. A seeded random draw freezes the outcome when you press the button; the capsule animation only reveals that already-fixed result.

faq.q: Can I draw several winners at once?
faq.a: Set the number of winners and it returns that many results with no duplicates.

ladder.title: Ladder Game
ladder.short: Watch the animal friends race down
ladder.tagline: A cute 2D ladder traced by the animals themselves
ladder.description: Choose a fixed cast of cute animals, edit only the outcomes below, and watch their faces follow a crisp 2D ladder through one paired edge portal. A seeded uniform permutation freezes the fair result first.

stage.aria: 2D ladder board with animal faces and one paired edge portal
stage.running: An animal friend is heading down
stage.tapAnimal: Tap an animal above to send them down one at a time
stage.routeHint: Tap a name to trace that route again.

setup.title: Match players with outcomes
setup.editHint: Choose the field and edit only the outcomes below
setup.portalHint: The two edge lanes connect through portals

result.title: Ladder results
result.subtitle: Tap a name to trace its route again.
result.selectHint: Tap a name to inspect its route

faq.q: How does the ladder game work?
faq.a: Choose the fixed animal field, edit the outcomes below, and press Start ladder. Colored tokens follow the rungs and paired edge portals to reveal each result.

faq.q: Do edge portals make it fairer?
faq.a: The fair result is chosen first from a seeded uniform permutation, independently of the portals. Portals give the two edge lanes a second visible direction while preserving that frozen result.

faq.q: Can I inspect each animal's route?
faq.a: Yes. After the result, tap an animal face at the top to highlight only that animal's path again.

race.title: Animal Race
race.tagline: Choose the field size and go — a 3D race packed with lead changes
race.description: Choose two to seven distinct animals and watch them charge down a long track. The winner and motion curves are seeded first, giving every animal an equal chance.

faq.q: How do I play the Animal Race?
faq.a: Choose two to seven animals and press Start. Tiger, horse, deer, dog, cat, penguin, and chicken race down a long track; there are no names to enter.
Yes. The champion, full finishing order, and motion curves are generated from seeded randomness, with an equal chance for every animal.

faq.q: Does the race play differently each time?
faq.a: Yes. Each start generates the champion, full order, and overtake timing together, producing a fresh comeback story.

fortune.title: Fortune Cookie
fortune.short: Pick a mood, then tap once
fortune.tagline: Choose luck, courage, connection, or comfort—then tap once
fortune.description: Choose the kind of message you need—luck, courage, connection, or comfort—then tap the fortune cookie. It presses and cracks in stages before revealing one seeded message on a thin paper slip.

stage.fallback: A fortune cookie making one short crisp crack

intro.kicker: PICK A MOOD · CRACK A COOKIE

faq.a: Pick luck, courage, connection, or comfort—whichever feels right now. Each category has its own built-in message bank, so there is nothing to type.
When you tap the cookie, one message from the selected category is frozen with seeded randomness. The progressive cookie animation only reveals that immutable result.

faq.q: Will One more give me a new message?
faq.a: Yes. One more restores the intact cookie and lets you draw a fresh message from the same category.
